body:
Setting: my room on computer chilling out. Afternoon, cool day outside in Florida, September. I start school tomorrow, so I hope I don't die.
12:48 - 2mg Etizolam (the idea is to get sedated and potentiate the MXE) 12:52 - Corona Extra beer - 12 Fl Oz, this should really sedate me and make the MXE hit me harder, I hope since I only have so much. (about 75mg mxe)
1:00 - I read that Sublingual administration is the best way to take MXE but I would rather snort it out of habit. - My favorite part of drug use is preparing the lines, bowls, joints Etc. Just gets me excited. - Have a small dose 25 mg MXE crushed nicely into a line.
1:02 - Snorted. And instantly feel a little sedation
1:03 - euphoria almost like an opiate in my mind and body, mild but present.
1:05 - I feel like jello in my mind and I am very in the moment and my surroundings are very pleasant.
1:06 - Very relaxing, euphoric and dissociative. Its like a blanket of no fucks being wrapped around my brain.
1:08 - I want to go deeper while I still have the chance to push this further so set out 10mg of mxe to snort.
1:09 - 10mg mxe down the nostral that isn't clogged up.
1:10 - My brain feels so nice and mellow, I want to share this with everyone, I want everyone to feel this with me.
I want everyone to feel this with me.
1:11 - Just wow, I never did do Ketamine but this is good enough that I don't even care to try K.
(just a note, the other night I did a lot (unknown amount) of mxe and I tripped so hard that I was living in the 3rd person, and it was enjoyable)
1:12 - still going strong, feeling euphoric and dissociated from reality, things look simpler, like they are almost a cartoon version of what they used to be.
1:15 - I feel like I DO NOT CARE about anything I am so euphoric and completely comfortable with life. - A very addictive state of mind that this drug creates.
1:16 - I feel the effects of the MXE strong now and I might be at the peak
1:20 - From here on out its just a slow tapering until I fade back into reality. Maybe smoking some weed would be nice on this level but it really doesn't need anything at all. What a wonderful drug. I hope it turns out to be safe because I would like to use this on weekends and at parties. But until a few more years of people using it we will not know what harm it does to us (maybe none?)
Also, from my experience and my friends, the next day there is NO hangover. Which is the bees knees.
1:30 - Ok I am starting to become myself again still euphoric and happy but not as intense. I have a feeling that in about 20 minutes I will be completely sober besides the beer and etizolam I took.
Please be safe with MXE but if using MXE alone I see no harm in doing doses of around 20-100mg.
